fullPassage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings \— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and to count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.

questions.passage: It would be hard to overstate how important meaningful work is to human beings \— work that provides a sense of fulfillment and empowerment. Those who have found deeper meaning in their careers find their days much more energizing and satisfying, and to count their employment as one of their greatest sources of joy and pride. Sonya Lyubomirsky, professor of psychology at the University of California, has conducted numerous workplace studies showing that when people are more fulfilled on the job, they not only produce higher quality work and a greater output, but also generally earn higher incomes. Those most satisfied with their work are also much more likely to be happier with their lives overall. For her book Happiness at Work, researcher Jessica Pryce-Jones conducted a study of 3,000 workers in seventy-nine countries, finding that those who took greater satisfaction from their work were 150 percent more likely to have a happier life overall.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주제: 의미 있는 일(meaningful work)이 삶의 만족도와 성과에 미치는 긍정적 영향
det.analysis:
① 의미 있는 일의 긍정적 영향 — 글 전체 주제 ← 정답
② 직장 내 경쟁 — 본문에 언급 없음
③ 수입이 유일한 조건 — 본문은 수입 외 만족도도 강조
④ 연구 방법론 한계 — 본문 주제와 무관
det.tip: 첫 문장의 핵심어 meaningful work가 주제

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 직업에서 의미를 찾으면 삶의 질과 업무 성과가 모두 향상된다
det.analysis:
① 고연봉→행복: 본문은 의미가 핵심이라고 주장
② 연구 신뢰 불가: 본문은 연구를 근거로 제시
③ 국가별 차이: 79개국 연구이지만 차이는 논점이 아님
④ 의미→삶의 질+성과: 글의 핵심 메시지 ← 정답

ch: 직업 만족도는 국가별로 큰 차이가 있다.
직업에서 의미를 찾는 것이 삶의 질과 업무 성과 모두를 향상시킨다.
